description: I like to explore the night sky and science hidden behind it.
summary:
Not Forgotten is a project that explores the stories of NASA's machines left across the solar system. Through this project, I take the audience on a journey from the Moon to Mars and beyond, introducing Apollo's lunar instruments, Mars rovers and the Voyager spacecraft. I explain why these machines were sent into space, what they discovered and what their missions mean to us today.
My aim is to make space exploration interesting and easy to understand, especially for young students. More than just presenting scientific facts, I want to show the people, curiosity and hard work behind these missions. Even when a machine stops working, the knowledge it leaves behind continues to help humanity explore the unknown.
Because sometimes, a mission may end, but its story never does.
details:
Project Details – Not Forgotten

Not Forgotten is an educational storytelling project that brings NASA's space exploration hardware to life. It takes the audience on a journey from the Moon to Mars and into deep space, introducing Apollo's lunar instruments, Mars rovers and the Voyager spacecraft.

Through a visual presentation, the project explains why these machines were sent into space, what they discovered and how they contributed to science. Rather than simply presenting technical facts, it tells their stories in an interesting and easy-to-understand way.

The project aims to make space science more engaging for school-age students and inspire curiosity about science, engineering and space exploration.

It was developed using presentation software and information collected from reliable NASA resources. No physical hardware or coding languages were required.

Its creativity lies in presenting space machines as more than equipment: they are part of humanity's journey to explore the unknown. Scientific accuracy, simplicity, visual appeal and age-appropriate explanations were considered throughout the project Message: A mission may end, but its discoveries live on.
